name: GetStockConfidenceExplanation
description: Explains why a stock confidence has a certain value
auth_description: Requires a user of type `Employee` or `Api` with functionality `StockConfidence:View`

headers.name: EVA-User-Agent
headers.description: The user agent that is making these calls. Don't make this specific per device/browser but per application. This should be of the form: `MyFirstUserAgent/1.0.0`

headers.name: EVA-Requested-OrganizationUnitID
headers.description: The ID of the organization unit to run this request in.

headers.name: EVA-Requested-OrganizationUnit-Query
headers.description: The query that selects the organization unit to run this request in.

headers.name: EVA-IDs-Mode
headers.description: The IDs mode to run this request in. Currently only `ExternalIDs` is supported.

headers.name: EVA-IDs-BackendSystemID
headers.description: The ID of the backend system that is used to resolve the IDs.

B.name: OrganizationUnitID
B.description: This is the ID of a `OrganizationUnit`

B.name: ProductID
B.description: This is the ID of a `Product`

F.name: AutomaticCorrectionQuantity
F.description: The quantity the system corrected automatically because the stock would have gone negative. When this is set, the confidence dropped to zero regardless of the reason.

F.name: Factor
F.description: The factor the confidence was multiplied with for this mutation

F.name: Quantity
F.description: The quantity of the stock mutation

F.name: Reason
F.description: The reason for the stock mutation

G.name: CreatedByID
G.description:
The user that changed the confidence, or null when the system did

This is the ID of a `User`

G.name: Factor
G.description: The factor the confidence was multiplied with

G.name: Type
G.description:
What kind of change this was
Possible values:

* `1` - Manual

E.name: StockMutation
E.description: Data for when it is a stockmutation entry

E.name: StoredEntry
E.description: Data for when it is a stored entry: a change that couldn't be deduced from other data, so it was stored when it happened

D.name: Data
D.description: The data of the entry, only one of its properties will ever be set

H.name: Code
H.description: A unique ID identifying this error.

H.name: Message
H.description: A human-readable message describing the error.

H.name: RequestID
H.description: A unique ID identifying the request. Please provide this ID when contacting support.

H.name: Type
H.description: A short description of the error type.

I.name: ExternalIDs
I.description: When using the `ExternalIDs` mode, this will hold the resolved external IDs.

I.name: IsAsyncResultAvailable
I.description: This is a flag indicating whether the async request is done. If it is `null`, it is not an async service. If it is `false`, the response is not yet available. Do not process the properties in that case. It is is `true` the properties are filled with the result of the call.

I.name: UnresolvedExternalIDs
I.description: When using the `ExternalIDs` mode, this will hold the external IDs we couldn't resolve.

J.name: CompletionTime
J.description: When the cycle count was completed. Null while it isn't.

J.name: CreationTime
J.description: When the cycle count was created

J.name: ID
J.description:
The ID of the cycle count

This is the ID of a `ZonedCycleCount`

J.name: IsCompleted
J.description: Whether the cycle count is completed

J.name: ResultStatus
J.description:
What the count found. `None` until it is completed.
Flags enum, combine any of the below values:

* `0` - None
* `1` - Correct
* `2` - RecountRequested
* `4` - Modified
* `8` - Deviated

J.name: SelectionBucket
J.description:
The failure mode the scoring engine created the count to catch. Null for counts the scoring engine didn't create.
Possible values:

* `1` - FalsePromise
* `2` - MissedSale
* `3` - Staleness

J.name: UserTaskID
J.description:
The user task the cycle count is carried out as

This is the ID of a `UserTask`

K.name: ConfidenceAtReset
K.description: The confidence that count left behind. Below 1 because it found a deviation: the bigger the deviation, the lower.

K.name: LastReset
K.description: When the similar product's last count reset its confidence

K.name: ProductID
K.description:
The similar product

This is the ID of a `Product`

K.name: ResetSource
K.description: The count that found the deviation, for example `ZCC:1234` for a cycle count or `FSC:321` for a full stock count

C.name: Confidence
C.description: The current confidence of the stock, including the decay since it was last reset. 0 when the product isn't tracked.

C.name: ConfidenceAtReset
C.description: The confidence the reset left behind: the value every entry below starts replaying from. Null when the product isn't tracked.

C.name: ConfidenceBeforeDecay
C.description: The confidence the entries below add up to, before decay over time is applied. Null when the product isn't tracked.

C.name: DaysOfCover
C.description: How many days the sellable stock lasts at the pace the product sold over the sales window (`CycleCount:V2:SalesRateWindowDays`). Null when nothing sold in that window, and when the product isn't tracked.

C.name: DaysSinceReset
C.description: How many days have passed since the last reset. Decay over time is applied over this period, unless the product is a confirmed zero. Null when the product isn't tracked.

C.name: Entries
C.description: Every change since the last reset, oldest first, each with the confidence around it. The last entry ends at the confidence before decay over time is applied.

C.name: HalfLifeDays
C.description: How many days it takes for decay over time to halve the confidence. Zero or less means the confidence doesn't decay over time. Null when the product isn't tracked.

C.name: IsConfirmedZero
C.description: Whether the product is a confirmed zero: enough counts in a row verified its empty shelf. A confirmed zero is parked, so no decay over time is applied to it. False when the product isn't tracked.

C.name: LastReset
C.description: When the confidence was last reset. Null when the product isn't tracked.

C.name: RecentCycleCounts
C.description: The most recent cycle counts of this product in this organization unit, newest first: the counting tasks that were, or weren't yet, done for it. Empty when the product isn't tracked.

C.name: ResetSource
C.description: What last reset the confidence, for example `ZCC:1234` for a cycle count, `FSC:321` for a full stock count, `INIT` when tracking started by itself or `MANUAL`. Null when the product isn't tracked.

C.name: SimilarProductsWithDeviations
C.description: The products sharing this product's parent product whose last count found a deviation, most recently counted first. A deviation next to this product makes its own stock level less believable. Empty when the product has no parent product, and when it isn't tracked.
